title: How to Write Essays in Chinese (1)
synopsis: Discover some practical tips to help you write better essays.

fullText.simplified:
怎样用中文写文章（一）

    很多外国学生在学中文的时候，会发现说中文比写中文容易。用中文写出的文章，中文老师会找到很多问题。那怎么才能写好一篇中文文章呢？
    在聊之前先跟大家说一些外国朋友用中文写文章时出现的问题：
    一是文章主题不符合现有汉语水平，导致越写越难，没法完成。外国朋友用中文写文章，应该先考虑自己目前的汉语水平，从现有水平开始，略难一些就可以。
    二是文章里的句子语言太过复杂，会出现用词典翻译的情况，造成句子不通顺、意思不合适等情况。我们应该尽量用学过的知识写句子，这样既可以复习学过的知识，又能保证内容的一致性。
    三是文章逻辑有些混乱。毕竟是用外语写文章，有时候受到母语影响或者其他原因，会出现文章前后逻辑不通的问题。这就需要提前写好提纲，想好结构。
    下面我们具体聊一下怎么写。
    首先，要确定好写什么，这个内容最好在你现在的汉语水平之内。从简单的开始，慢慢提高。你也可以在写文章以前，把学过的汉语词汇、语法、句型什么的先整理出来，尤其是语法部分，它是文章的框架，组成句子的基础。整理好词汇语法后，写起来会比较快。
    其次确定好文章结构。一般我们会经常写写事的文章。写事的文章需要包括写事六要素：时间、地点、人物、原因、经过、结果。简单来说就是什么时间，谁，在什么地方，发生了一件什么事，为什么发生，结果是什么。一般来讲，最少三段。事情经过是文章的重点，会单独一段。
    最后，我们一般会总结一下文章，说说感受或者结果。
    为了保证文章逻辑清楚，可以写几句就从头读一遍，边写边读，这样就可以知道前边写了什么，又可以让后边写的句子与前边保持一致。
    以上就是我们用中文写文章的一些方法。下回我们会实际用一篇外国朋友用中文写的文章，讲解一下具体是怎么写作的。
fullText.traditional:
怎樣用中文寫文章（一）

    很多外國學生在學中文的時候，會發現說中文比寫中文容易。用中文寫出的文章，中文老師會找到很多問題。那怎麼才能寫好一篇中文文章呢？
    在聊之前先跟大家說一些外國朋友用中文寫文章時出現的問題：
    一是文章主題不符合現有漢語水平，導致越寫越難，沒法完成。外國朋友用中文寫文章，應該先考慮自己目前的漢語水平，從現有水平開始，略難一些就可以。
    二是文章裡的句子語言太過複雜，會出現用詞典翻譯的情況，造成句子不通順、意思不合適等情況。我們應該儘量用學過的知識寫句子，這樣既可以復習學過的知識，又能保證內容的一致性。
    三是文章邏輯有些混亂。畢竟是用外語寫文章，有時候受到母語影響或者其他原因，會出現文章前後邏輯不通的問題。這就需要提前寫好提綱，想好結構。
    下面我們具體聊一下怎麼寫。
    首先，要確定好寫什麼，這個內容最好在你現在的漢語水平之內。從簡單的開始，慢慢提高。你也可以在寫文章以前，把學過的漢語詞彙、語法、句型甚麼的先整理出來，尤其是語法部分，它是文章的框架，組成句子的基礎。整理好詞彙語法後，寫起來會比較快。
    其次確定好文章結構。一般我們會經常寫寫事的文章。寫事的文章需要包括寫事六要素：時間、地點、人物、原因、經過、結果。簡單來說就是什麼時間，誰，在什麼地方，發生了一件什麼事，為什麼發生，結果是什麼。一般來講，最少三段。事情經過是文章的重點，會單獨一段。
    最後，我們一般會總結一下文章，說說感受或者結果。
    為了保證文章邏輯清楚，可以寫幾句就從頭讀一遍，邊寫邊讀，這樣就可以知道前邊寫了什麼，又可以讓後邊寫的句子與前邊保持一致。
    以上就是我們用中文寫文章的一些方法。下回我們會實際用一篇外國朋友用中文寫的文章，講解一下具體是怎麼寫作的。

sentences.traditional: 外國朋友用中文寫文章，應該先考慮自己目前的漢語水平，

sentences.simplified: 从现有水平开始，略难一些就可以。
sentences.traditional: 從現有水平開始，略難一些就可以。
sentences.pinyin: cóng xiàn yǒu shuǐ píng kāi shǐ lüè nán yì xiē jiù kě yǐ
sentences.english: When foreigners write essays in Chinese, they should first consider their current Chinese level.
The difficulty should be just a bit higher than their current level.

sentences.simplified: 二是文章里的句子语言太过复杂，
sentences.traditional: 二是文章裡的句子語言太過複雜，

sentences.traditional: 會出現用詞典翻譯的情況，
sentences.pinyin: huì chū xiàn yòng cí diǎn fān yì de qíng kuàng
sentences.english: The second issue is that the language of the sentences in the essay is too complex.

sentences.simplified: 造成句子不通顺、意思不合适等情况。
sentences.traditional: 造成句子不通順、意思不合適等情況。
sentences.pinyin: zào chéng jù zi bù tōng shùn yì si bù hé shì děng qíng kuàng
sentences.english: There are often instances of direct translation using a dictionary, ..

sentences.traditional: 我們應該儘量用學過的知識寫句子，

sentences.simplified: 这样既可以复习学过的知识，又能保证内容的一致性。
sentences.traditional: 這樣既可以復習學過的知識，又能保證內容的一致性。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng jì kě yǐ fù xí xué guò de zhī shi yòu néng bǎo zhèng nèi róng de yí zhì xìng
sentences.english: We should write sentences using what we have learned before as much as possible.
This way, we can review what we have learned previously, as well as ensure consistency of the content.

sentences.simplified: 三是文章逻辑有些混乱。
sentences.traditional: 三是文章邏輯有些混亂。
sentences.pinyin: sān shì wén zhāng luó ji yǒu xiē hùn luàn

sentences.simplified: 毕竟是用外语写文章，
sentences.traditional: 畢竟是用外語寫文章，
sentences.pinyin: bì jìng shì yòng wài yǔ xiě wén zhāng
sentences.english: The third is that the logic in the essay is somewhat confused.

sentences.simplified: 有时候受到母语影响或者其他原因，会出现文章前后逻辑不通的问题。
sentences.traditional: 有時候受到母語影響或者其他原因，會出現文章前後邏輯不通的問題。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hou shòu dào mǔ yǔ yǐng xiǎng huò zhě qí tā yuán yīn huì chū xiàn wén zhāng qián hòu luó ji bù tōng de wèn tí
sentences.english: After all, this is writing in a foreign language.

sentences.simplified: 这就需要提前写好提纲，想好结构。
sentences.traditional: 這就需要提前寫好提綱，想好結構。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù xū yào tí qián xiě hǎo tí gāng xiǎng hǎo jié gòu
sentences.english: Sometimes due to influence of the native language or other factors, the essay will have unclear logic throughout.
This is why it’s necessary to write an outline and plan the structure beforehand.

sentences.simplified: 下面我们具体聊一下怎么写。
sentences.traditional: 下面我們具體聊一下怎麼寫。
sentences.pinyin: xià miàn wǒ men jù tǐ liáo yí xià zěn me xiě

sentences.english: Next, we’ll talk in detail about how to write.

sentences.simplified: 首先，要确定好写什么，这个内容最好在你现在的汉语水平之内。
sentences.traditional: 首先，要確定好寫什麼，這個內容最好在你現在的漢語水平之內。
sentences.pinyin: shǒu xiān yào què dìng hǎo xiě shén me zhè ge nèi róng zuì hǎo zài nǐ xiàn zài de hàn yǔ shuǐ píng zhī nèi

sentences.simplified: 从简单的开始，慢慢提高。
sentences.traditional: 從簡單的開始，慢慢提高。
sentences.pinyin: cóng jiǎn dān de kāi shǐ màn man tí gāo
sentences.english: First, you need to decide what to write about. It’s best if this topic is within your current Chinese level.

sentences.simplified: 你也可以在写文章以前，
sentences.traditional: 你也可以在寫文章以前，
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yě kě yǐ zài xiě wén zhāng yǐ qián
sentences.english: You can start with something easy and then gradually move on to more difficult topics.

sentences.simplified: 把学过的汉语词汇、语法、句型什么的先整理出来，
sentences.traditional: 把學過的漢語詞彙、語法、句型甚麼的先整理出來，
sentences.pinyin: bǎ xué guò de hàn yǔ cí huì yǔ fǎ jù xíng shén me de xiān zhěng lǐ chu lai
sentences.english: Before starting to write your essay, ..

sentences.simplified: 尤其是语法部分，它是文章的框架，组成句子的基础。
sentences.traditional: 尤其是語法部分，它是文章的框架，組成句子的基礎。
sentences.pinyin: yóu qí shì yǔ fǎ bù fen tā shì wén zhāng de kuàng jià zǔ chéng jù zi de jī chǔ
sentences.english: .. you can also organize the Chinese vocabulary, grammar, sentence patterns, and so on that you have learned.

sentences.simplified: 整理好词汇语法后，写起来会比较快。
sentences.traditional: 整理好詞彙語法後，寫起來會比較快。
sentences.pinyin: zhěng lǐ hǎo cí huì yǔ fǎ hòu xiě qǐ lái huì bǐ jiào kuài
sentences.english: Grammar is especially important, as it’s the framework of the essay and the basis for sentence building.
After you sort out the vocabulary and grammar, you’ll be able to write faster.

sentences.simplified: 其次确定好文章结构。一般我们会经常写写事的文章。
sentences.traditional: 其次確定好文章結構。一般我們會經常寫寫事的文章。
sentences.pinyin: qí cì què dìng hǎo wén zhāng jié gòu yì bān wǒ men huì jīng cháng xiě xiě shì de wén zhāng

sentences.simplified: 写事的文章需要包括写事六要素：时间、地点、人物、原因、经过、结果。
sentences.traditional: 寫事的文章需要包括寫事六要素：時間、地點、人物、原因、經過、結果。
sentences.pinyin: xiě shì de wén zhāng xū yào bāo kuò xiě shì liù yào sù shí jiān dì diǎn rén wù yuán yīn jīng guò jié guǒ
sentences.english: Next comes finalizing the structure of your essay. We often work on narrative writing.

sentences.simplified: 简单来说就是什么时间，谁，在什么地方，发生了一件什么事，为什么发生，结果是什么。
sentences.traditional: 簡單來說就是什麼時間，誰，在什麼地方，發生了一件什麼事，為什麼發生，結果是什麼。
sentences.pinyin: jiǎn dān lái shuō jiù shì shén me shí jiān shéi zài shén me dì fang fā shēng le yí jiàn shén me shì wèi shén me fā shēng jié guǒ shì shén me
sentences.english: Narrative writing must include six elements: time, location, people, reason, course of events, and result.

sentences.simplified: 一般来讲，最少三段。
sentences.traditional: 一般來講，最少三段。
sentences.pinyin: yì bān lái jiǎng zuì shǎo sān duàn
sentences.english: In simpler terms, this means when, who, where, what happens, why it happens, and what the result is.

sentences.simplified: 事情经过是文章的重点，会单独一段。
sentences.traditional: 事情經過是文章的重點，會單獨一段。
sentences.pinyin: shì qing jīng guò shì wén zhāng de zhòng diǎn huì dān dú yí duàn
sentences.english: Generally speaking, this should be at least three paragraphs.
The course of events is the focal point, so it will form a separate paragraph.

sentences.simplified: 最后，我们一般会总结一下文章，说说感受或者结果。
sentences.traditional: 最後，我們一般會總結一下文章，說說感受或者結果。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu wǒ men yì bān huì zǒng jié yí xià wén zhāng shuō shuō gǎn shòu huò zhě jié guǒ

sentences.english: Lastly, we will typically summarize the essay, discussing impressions or a result.

sentences.simplified: 为了保证文章逻辑清楚，
sentences.traditional: 為了保證文章邏輯清楚，
sentences.pinyin: wèi le bǎo zhèng wén zhāng luó ji qīng chu

sentences.simplified: 可以写几句就从头读一遍，边写边读，
sentences.traditional: 可以寫幾句就從頭讀一遍，邊寫邊讀，
sentences.pinyin: kě yǐ xiě jǐ jù jiù cóng tóu dú yí biàn biān xiě biān dú
sentences.english: In order to make sure that the logic of your essay is clear, ..

sentences.simplified: 这样就可以知道前边写了什么，
sentences.traditional: 這樣就可以知道前邊寫了什麼，
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng jiù kě yǐ zhī dào qián bian xiě le shén me
sentences.english: .. you can read it from the beginning every time you finish writing a few sentences, reading while writing.

sentences.simplified: 又可以让后边写的句子与前边保持一致。
sentences.traditional: 又可以讓後邊寫的句子與前邊保持一致。
sentences.pinyin: yòu kě yǐ ràng hòu bian xiě de jù zi yǔ qián bian bǎo chí yí zhì
sentences.english: This way, you will know what has already been written.
You can also make sure that the sentences you’re about to write are consistent with what has been written previously.

sentences.simplified: 以上就是我们用中文写文章的一些方法。
sentences.traditional: 以上就是我們用中文寫文章的一些方法。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ shàng jiù shì wǒ men yòng zhōng wén xiě wén zhāng de yì xiē fāng fǎ

sentences.traditional: 下回我們會實際用一篇外國朋友用中文寫的文章，講解一下具體是怎麼寫作的。

sentences.english: Above are some of the methods that we can use when writing Chinese essays.
Next time we will use an actual Chinese essay written by a foreigner in order to explain exactly how to write essays.

raw.synopsis: Discover some practical tips to help you write better essays.
sentence_translations: How to Write Essays in Chinese (1)
When learning Chinese, many foreign students find that speaking Chinese is easier than writing Chinese.
Chinese teachers find a lot of problems in essays written in Chinese by foreigners.
Well, in that case, how does one write a good essay in Chinese?
Before we begin talking about this, let’s first discuss some issues that occur in Chinese essays written by foreigners.
The first issue is when the essay topic does not match the student’s current Chinese level.
This leads to the essay becoming more and more difficult, so it can’t be completed.
When foreigners write essays in Chinese, they should first consider their current Chinese level.
The difficulty should be just a bit higher than their current level.
The second issue is that the language of the sentences in the essay is too complex.
There are often instances of direct translation using a dictionary, ..
.. which causes situations such as incoherent sentences and improper meanings.
We should write sentences using what we have learned before as much as possible.
This way, we can review what we have learned previously, as well as ensure consistency of the content.
The third is that the logic in the essay is somewhat confused.
After all, this is writing in a foreign language.
Sometimes due to influence of the native language or other factors, the essay will have unclear logic throughout.
This is why it’s necessary to write an outline and plan the structure beforehand.
Next, we’ll talk in detail about how to write.
First, you need to decide what to write about. It’s best if this topic is within your current Chinese level.
You can start with something easy and then gradually move on to more difficult topics.
Before starting to write your essay, ..
.. you can also organize the Chinese vocabulary, grammar, sentence patterns, and so on that you have learned.
Grammar is especially important, as it’s the framework of the essay and the basis for sentence building.
After you sort out the vocabulary and grammar, you’ll be able to write faster.
Next comes finalizing the structure of your essay. We often work on narrative writing.
Narrative writing must include six elements: time, location, people, reason, course of events, and result.
In simpler terms, this means when, who, where, what happens, why it happens, and what the result is.
Generally speaking, this should be at least three paragraphs.
The course of events is the focal point, so it will form a separate paragraph.
Lastly, we will typically summarize the essay, discussing impressions or a result.
In order to make sure that the logic of your essay is clear, ..
.. you can read it from the beginning every time you finish writing a few sentences, reading while writing.
This way, you will know what has already been written.
You can also make sure that the sentences you’re about to write are consistent with what has been written previously.
Above are some of the methods that we can use when writing Chinese essays.
Next time we will use an actual Chinese essay written by a foreigner in order to explain exactly how to write essays.
